Nina T: quick thought: can we let customers bootstrap Private controlplane with a one-shot 'onboard claim' instead of immediate peering? low-friction for trials.
Raj S: sounds useful. sketch the flow?
Nina T: agent requests a claim_id from CP (console/API), receives a single-use signed blob tied to agent pubkey. agent then opens outbound mTLS using that blob and gets a short-lived tenant cert + route assertion. no VPC attachment required to start.
Evan M: how do we bind it to a machine so attacker can't replay?
Nina T: claim includes agent_pubkey_fingerprint and nonce. server marks claim CONSUMED on first successful handshake. also require connection within N minutes.
infra-bot: note: metrics to add -> onboard_claims.created, onboard_claims.consumed, onboard_claims.revoked. rate-limit per-account.
Priya (prod): product notes: UX must show claim TTL and consumed_by_ip in audit log. enterprise mode should allow shared "team claims" with explicit opt-in.
Raj S: network fallbacks? not all customers have PrivateLink.
Nina T: fallback to regional relay. we'll quantify relay cost + latency for 3 scales.
Evan M: failure states? if agent gets cert but then fails to create endpoint routes, we need revoke + GC.
Nina T: agree. plan: short revoke API and automatic GC after expiry. edge validates expiry in route assertions.
Priya (prod): add admin revoke in console and email hooks for onboarding failures.
Raj S: security pairing: also require proof-of-possession via KMS-signed nonce for high-security accounts.
Nina T: next actions: spike cost model + simple RFC draft. i'll pair with Raj on threat model.
Evan M: i'll look at edge checks and GC windows.
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1402 to track relay capacity estimation.
